notes.title: Haunted Hallows Release!
notes.content:
Check out the new full-fledged game mode "Haunted Hallows"! 

You've been shipwrecked on a haunted island and must explore to collect enough materials to fix your ship and return home! Or, you can choose to find clues and uncover what sent the civilization there into darkness, maybe you can help free them? Just beware, haunted spirits have been spotted wandering the shores looking for their next victim!

[list]
[*] Full single-player mode released
[*] 3-player multiplayer co-op supported (Multiplayer to be released in September)
[*] Full achievement support
[*] Leaderboards
[*] Special customization unlocks
[/list] 

Stay tuned to our Steam page and Discord for future updates and announcements!

Regards,
Yooper Game Studios LLC

[previewyoutube=KHKyBb9kwCo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Drive Up?! Game Mode Update!
notes.content:
Inspired by "Getting Over It" and other "Only Up" games, "Drive Up?!" single player game mode has been added to Super Battle Polycars!

Take the Roadster with its preset "Jump" and "Boost" abilities up a challenging tower with multiple obstacles on your way to the peak. But be careful not to fall, or it is game over!

Updates:
- "Drive Up?!" game mode added to single player game mode menu
- Achievements activated for "Drive Up?!"
- Special hidden cosmetics added tied to achievements
- Leaderboard added for "Drive Up?!"

Hop into the official Yooper Game Studios Discord server to stay up-to-date with the community for future content drops and announcements!

Regards,
Yooper Game Studios LLC

Discord:
https://discord.gg/yoopergamestudiosllc

notes.title: Time Trials and Achievements Update!
notes.content:
Hit the Polygon road and compete for a top spot on the global in-game leaderboards with the new Time Trials single player game mode! The update will be live shortly at 12am UTC 8/15/2024.

[list]
[*] New Time Trial for each map
[*] Top 15 times displayed on the leaderboards
[*] Race through each checkpoint and break all green targets to win!
[/list]

Alongside that, a total of 56 Steam achievements have been added to the game! These achievements span across all released and soon-to-be released game modes and progression passes. We hope players enjoy chasing after these challenges!

Minor networking fixes and weapon balancing have also been implemented. Check back here on Steam for a future patch-note breakdown.

Thank you all for your support of Super Battle Polycars during Early Access! More details on future game modes and updates to be announced shortly!

Regards,
Yooper Game Studios LLC

notes.title: Early Access Release Update!
notes.content:
Hello all Polycar enthusiasts! Start your engines!

[u][i]Introduction[/i][/u]
Solo indie dev/publisher for Yooper Game Studios here, and I am excited to give you all the details for the Super Battle Polycars Steam Early Access Release!

The last couple months have been quite the world wind, many late nights spent gathering feedback from the community and implementing features and bug-fixes to give players itching for some vehicular destruction a place to scratch. Below lists the newest features, maps, and QOL improvements alongside existing gameplay elements to catch anyone up looking to drive onto the polygon road solo or with their friends!

A big thank you to all the support from players, streamers, influencers, content creators, and lovers of vehicular combat that has pushed the game across the Early Access finish line. Be sure to hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/yoopergamestudiosllc]Discord[/url] channel to find other players, report bugs, leave feedback, talk about the game, or just to say hi!

Keep a look out for the Early Access Development Roadmap to be released shortly. A full PC and PS5 cross-play release is revving up for Q1 2025, stay tuned!

You can find additional details in our official [url=https://www.yoopergamestudios.com/manuals]game manual[/url].

[u][i]Polycars[/i][/u]
Individual Polycars vary in total HP, top speed, acceleration, handling, and is equipped with 3 unique abilities and 1 ultimate ability to use in combat. There are 3 Polycars available upon Early Access release with more to come!

Roadster:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891599/cb2f17c7d79c739c500fa035e8e519389de31978.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The fastest Polycar with the highest acceleration. Abilities are meant to be used as escape tools or to out-range your opponents.
[*] Max Health: 75hp
[*] Agent Rifle: Fire out a lightning-fast light bullet that does low damage. It is good at range and can hit across large maps. Upgrades for this ability changes this weapon into a burst-fire.
[*] Purple Waste: Lobs blinding purple radioactive waste canisters onto the field. Enemies who run into them take a high amount of damage. Upgrading this ability fires out multiple canisters with each attack. Good for losing people who might want to chase you.
[*] Plasma: A slower moving bullet projectile that does radial damage. Upgrading this ability increases its effectiveness.
[*] Nightlight: (Ultimate) Triggers a large orbital flash bang, blinding all you happen to be looking in that direction. Does moderate radial damage to those trapped inside.
[/list]

Muscle:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891599/c0079a99f95bda9ba8ab557ca55cfed9d4bf0abb.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A chunky alternative that has a slower top-speed and is harder to use. Abilities are slow but do heavy damage. 
[*] Max Health: 100hp
[*] Rockets: Fire a slow-moving rocket that does high impact radial damage. Good for slowing down opponents that happen to get in the way. Upgrading this ability does more damage on impact.
[*] Cluster: Sends a cluster of 3 fireballs out the front of the vehicle for good close-range damage.
[*] Bomber: Lob out a heavy low-arching bomb that does good radial damage.
[*] Kinetic Strike: (Ultimate) Call down missiles from the sky onto the green marker placed on the ground in front of you. A high damage, but high cooldown intensive attack for clearing out a group.
[/list]

Truck:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891599/c46211dedaab825cd68968c3fa11438162c29cb4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The slowest Polycar with good acceleration. Works best when it can get close and personal to the action.
[*] Max Health: 120hp
[*] Slash: Unleash a close-range sweep attack that bounces your enemies up into the air. Upgrading this ability allows for longer sweep distance and damage.
[*] Grenade: Chuck high-arching grenades to take enemies by surprise. Upgrading this ability awards shorter cooldowns and greater number of grenades fired.
[*] Poison: Throw out a poison bomb that does tick damage to those caught inside driving through. Upgrading this ability awards longer poison cloud duration and tick damage.
[*] Barrier: (Ultimate) Used to block incoming attacks and push other Polycars around by spawning the barrier in front of your Truck grill.
[/list]

[u][i]Items[/i][/u]
Every Polycar has access to a variety of items to equip onto their rig in the garage. Below lists the available items and how they can help you destroy your opponents in battle.

[list]
[*] Boost: Temporarily give your engine some nitro to accelerate away from your opponents!
[*] Spring: Slap on some over-powered hydraulics to jump your Polycar into the sky! Good for evading slow or ground based abilites.
[*] Smoke: Obscure your enemy's vision by throwing down a cloud of smoke, temporarily makes you go invisible.
[*] Teleport: Quickly zap out of existence and out of range by warping time and space! Just be careful you don't zap into danger or out-of-bounds.
[*] Fuel Up: Low on health? Take this. Feel better.
[/list]

[u][i]Gamemodes[/i][/u]
Below are the available game modes and tutorials ready for chaotic multiplayer combat! 
NOTE: When matchmaking games will not start until a full lobby is found.

[list]
[*] FFA Deathmatch: 
[list]
[*] 4-player free for all. 
[*] Not available when in a party. 
[*] Random map selection. 
[/list]
[*] Team Deathmatch: 
[list] 
[*] 3v3
[*] Available for both solo queuing and in a party. 
[*] Random map selection.
[/list]
[*] Private Match: 
[list]
[*] The host pulls their party into a FFA deathmatch. 
[*] Max party size is 3. 
[*] Not available solo. 
[*] Map selected by host. 
[/list]
[*] MOVA: (Coming August 2025) 
[list]
[*] Massive Online Vehicle Arena. 
[*] 3v3. 
[*] Level up, destroy the enemy team's tower before they do! 
[*] Available for both solo queuing and in a party. 
[*] Random map selection. 
[/list]
[/list]

[u][i]Maps[/i][/u]
Battle across ancient islands and charred lava landscapes to secluded mountain regions!

Scrub Town:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891599/5a69fe0d75d84b390e16ca2db564c071f18eb2db.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Map Size: Large
[*] Located in an undisclosed area within a secluded mountain region
[*] Large open track circles around an interior prop town and forest area
[*] Lose opponents by gaining speed and ramping off the side jumps into the night sky
[*] Turrets, cannons, and a neutral enemy tower spawn at set times throughout play
[/list]

Polygon Island:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891599/7c888636723f59ea43c18d9040f4796cd1d8c57d.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Map Size: Medium
[*] Battle it out on an ancient island in the middle of the ocean
[*] Use the docks to gain the high ground, or climb the track to jump over the map
[*] A lone highway surrounded by palm trees is your only place to hit the gas
[*] Weave around palm trees and ruins to evade or chase opponents
[*] Don't fall in the water!
[/list]

The Pit:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891599/81faac52fa3f5e07332bc4e1c0cf0f3a325c22b9.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Map Size: Small
[*] Fight off your enemies surrounded by the underworld's charred lava landscape
[*] Navigate around the molten river or find a different way to cross over to the other side
[*] Duck and drift through other-worldly artifacts and obstacles
[*] Be careful not to get thrown into the lava!
[/list]

[u][i]Customization Options[/i][/u]
Kit your Polycar with different hats, gliders, polycar paints, and HUD speedometers unlocked with the free Main and Early Access progression passes! (i.e. battle passes)

Main Progression Pass:

Yooper Game Studios LLC

notes.title: Demo Update av0.05
notes.content:
Thank you to all who provided feedback! Patch notes for the most recent alpha version av0.05 is live, and can be played by downloading the demo right now!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Reduced deathmatch FFA to 4 players due to previous long wait times.
[*] Optimized graphics for lower-end hardware. Removed unnecessary foliage and world instances.
[*] Added rear camera view. Press left-alt on MKB, and d-pad down on controller.
[*] Added aiming reticles for all Polycars, giving players a better view of their weapon placement.
[*] Fixed vehicles not replicating customization options or duplicating host options at the beginning of a match.
[*] Fixed heath bar information showing incorrect images and usernames.
[*] Fixed bug where game occasionally crashes when going back to the main menu from the options window.
[*] Fixed bug where custom plate text would not load on game start.
[/list]

I am still going through feedback and working to improve the player experience. Drop into our official Discord and leave comments and/or suggestions so we can make Super Battle Polycars fun for everyone!

- Yooper Game Studios LLC

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content:
Newly released game demo contains 4 tutorial levels to hone your Polycar driving skills before the early access release!

[u]Driving:[/u]
[list]
[*] Get a feel for controlling your Polycar either with controller or mouse and keyboard
[/list]

[u]Weapons:[/u]
[list]
[*] Take control of the Muscle Polycar and blast down targets, practicing your aim in the arena!
[/list]

[u]Items & Progression:[/u]
[list]
[*] Learn how your Polycar levels up and uses items during a match. Take out that knowledge on some AI derby cars for good measure!
[/list]

[u]Advanced:[/u]
[list]
[*] Put your skills to the test in a timed course, move through all the objectives and shoot down the targets to win!
[/list]

Look out for demo updates in the future, where we will include online deathmatch, team deathmatch, and the MOVA game-modes as we approach Next Fest in June! 

See you all on the Polygon road!

- Yooper Game Studios
